candidates.title: BigMoMo: Efficient Inference of Large-Scale MoE with Speculative Decoding on Mobile Devices
candidates.reason: 投機的復号窓をexpert weight再利用、Flash連続読出し、NPU load-compute overlapへ利用する新着mobile MoE runtimeで実機評価がある。

candidates.title: APEX: Adaptive Expert Prefetching for Memory-Efficient Edge MoE Inference
candidates.reason: confidence-based expert prefetchによりoff-chip expert loadingを計算と重畳し、正確性維持モードで遅延・energy-delayを評価。

candidates.title: HetRoute Heterogeneous and Cost-aware Collaborative Routing Framework for Distributed Edge MoE Inference
candidates.reason: 通信、GPU-CPU offload、queueing、量子化品質を統合したexpert placement/residency/routingを10-server testbedで評価。

candidates.title: OrderMoE: An expert similarity driven distributed edge MoE inference
candidates.reason: expert similarityを用いた分散配置とruntime server-expert選択により通信・tail latencyを実機testbedで削減。

discovery_stats.query_summary: 2026年7〜9月のedge MoE、speculative decoding、expert prefetch、distributed routingを探索。
